No astronomical discs, Sun, Neptune, rings or stars in this local view. No spacecraft, people, vegetation, biology, liquid, ocean, plume, atmospheric haze or survivable landing implication. No other text. Scientifically restrained, naturalistic texture, no dramatic mountains or dramatic glow.
